facts.position: At the center of the solar system
facts.mean_solar_distance_au: 0 AU (the reference point for solar distance)
facts.orbital_period_earth_days: About 225 million years around the center of the Milky Way
facts.rotation_period: About 25 days at the equator; the poles rotate more slowly
facts.axial_tilt: About 7.25 degrees relative to the plane of Earth's orbit
facts.atmosphere: Layers include the photosphere, chromosphere, and corona
facts.signature_fact: Nuclear fusion in its core converts hydrogen into helium and releases the light and heat that power life on Earth.
facts.surface_temperature_c: Visible photosphere is about 5,500 degrees Celsius; the corona is much hotter
facts.composition: About 74% hydrogen and 24% helium by mass, with small amounts of heavier elements
facts.surface_features: A roiling plasma surface with sunspots, granules, prominences, and coronal loops
facts.magnetic_field: A changing magnetic field that reverses polarity roughly every 11 years
facts.escape_velocity_km_s: About 618 km/s at the visible surface
facts.discovery: Known since prehistory; its nature as a star became clear through centuries of astronomy
facts.exploration: Studied by observatories and spacecraft including SOHO, Parker Solar Probe, and Solar Orbiter
facts.water: No liquid water; the Sun is hot plasma, not a solid world
facts.weather: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections release energy and charged particles into space
facts.formation_age: Formed about 4.6 billion years ago from a collapsing cloud of gas and dust
facts.orbital_eccentricity: Not applicable (the Sun does not orbit itself)
facts.orbital_inclination_degrees: Not applicable (the Sun does not orbit itself)
facts.orbital_speed_km_s: Not applicable (the Sun does not orbit itself)

facts.position: Earth's natural satellite; Earth is the third planet from the Sun
facts.mean_solar_distance_au: About 0.00257 AU from Earth (384,400 km on average)
facts.rotation_period: 27.3 days; synchronous rotation keeps nearly the same side facing Earth
facts.axial_tilt: About 6.7 degrees relative to its orbital plane
facts.atmosphere: An extremely thin exosphere, not breathable air
facts.signature_fact: The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth, by about 3.8 centimeters each year.
facts.surface_temperature_c: About -173 degrees Celsius at night to 127 degrees Celsius in daylight
facts.composition: Silicate rock with a small iron-rich core
facts.surface_features: Impact craters, ancient lava plains called maria, mountains, and permanently shadowed polar regions
facts.magnetic_field: No global magnetic field today, though some crustal rocks are locally magnetized
facts.discovery: Earth's natural companion, observed since prehistory
facts.exploration: Visited by robotic missions and astronauts; Apollo 11 first landed people there in 1969
facts.water: Water ice occurs in some permanently shadowed polar craters
facts.weather: No ordinary weather; the surface is exposed to vacuum, radiation, and micrometeorites
facts.formation_age: Formed about 4.5 billion years ago, likely after a large impact with early Earth
